name: LibreChat
tagline: Open-source AI chat workspace supporting local endpoints, custom presets, code interpreter, and plugins.
real_test_summary: Tested self-hosting LibreChat connected to a local OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint with saved prompt presets and conversation branching. Keeps chat history and configurations under local control.
pros: Supports local endpoints, multi-chat branching, and reusable presets
Permissive MIT license with active open-source development
Clean multi-model chat UI with artifact and code rendering
cons: Full self-hosted deployment relies on Docker and database services
Initial setup takes more steps than a single desktop binary
